text:
noah (secops): FYI: internal fuzzing found an unauthenticated /debug/console endpoint on dedicated-controlplane.customer-qa.redwood.net that allows code execution in the control-plane proxy.
jess (platform): whoa. which cluster/tenant?
noah (secops): found in dedicated-qa-east-1, tenant id tidy-analytics. attacker could POST a payload to /debug/console which spawns a shell. PoC included in vuln-scan output.
ravi (dedicated-support): confirmed with curl in a sandbox. this endpoint should never be exposed publicly — looks like a NGINX location left enabled from a debug build.
noah (secops): immediate mitigation checklist: 1) add ingress deny rule for that hostname 2) roll controlplane pods with DEBUG=false image 3) revoke any session tokens minted in last 24h for tidy-analytics 4) run artifact scan for other debug flags.
alice (priv-deploy): I'm patching the NGINX config across dedicated clusters now. pushing hotfix image tag platform/controlplane:stable-hotfix-20261011.
deploy-bot: deploy started: platform/controlplane stable-hotfix-20261011 -> dedicated-qa-east-1 (rolling).
jess (platform): I'll push a global ingress policy to block /debug/* on the LB. Creating INFRA-TICKET to add a WAF rule too.
noah (secops): sec-bot created SEC-2026-1010. Priority: P1. Runbook: https://confluence.internal/redwood/security/runbooks/controlplane-debug-exposure
ravi (dedicated-support): token revocation: ran `scripts/revoke_sessions.sh --tenant tidy-analytics --since 24h` and restarted auth-cache.
noah (secops): please collect access logs for tidy-analytics from last 7 days and share suspect IPs. Also rotate any service keys referenced in those logs.
jess (platform): logs pulled, suspicious IPs: 34.120.12.9, 13.37.99.21 — forwarding to sec for enrichment.
alice (priv-deploy): hotfix rollout completed in qa cluster. verifying LB rejects /debug now.
noah (secops): can someone run a smoke that tries to hit /debug/console externally?
ravi (dedicated-support): external probe blocked returning 403 after WAF change. internal curl still able on kube-api port but controlplane image no longer exposes console.
sec-bot: SEC-2026-1010 status -> mitigated (hotfix deployed, ingress & token revocation applied).
noah (secops): follow-ups: - audit all controlplane images for debug flags (assign: platform) - add auto-deny WAF rule for debug paths (assign: infra) - create monitoring alert for any new 2xx on /debug/console (assign: obs) - notify affected customer tidy-analytics with post-incident summary (assign: cs/security liaison). Target: notify by EOD.
jess (platform): opened PLAT-5991 to scan images and PLAT-5992 to add unit test preventing debug location in conf. ETA next sprint for scan, hotfix rule deployed now.
noah (secops): customer comm draft in #customer-success for review. tagging @ravi to handle notifications.
ravi (dedicated-support): will coordinate with CS; preparing a brief and timeline.
noah (secops): thanks all. keep thread updated if any related findings.
